questions.prompt: Under the gun opens to 3bb. You are next to act with 72o. Best action?
questions.explanation: Do not continue trash against an early open. There is no blocker or playability.

questions.prompt: Cutoff opens, you are on the button with AQs at 100bb. A sound continue is…

choices.text: Call or 3-bet. Both are ahead of folding.
Limp after the open, which is not a legal call
All-in for 100bb as the only continue

questions.explanation: AQs is too strong to fold to one late open. Calling in position or 3-betting are both real continues.

questions.prompt: Which hand is a better 3-bet bluff than a call against a late open?
questions.explanation: A5s blocks aces and can make a nut flush when called. Random offsuit hands do not.

questions.prompt: You are out of position versus an early open with KJo. Why is flatting the common mistake?

choices.text: KJo is the nuts against an early range.
You are required to 3-bet every king.
You are dominated and will play the flop first against a stronger range.

questions.explanation: KJo versus a tight early open is a fold more often than a call.
